analysis:
The only change in this PR is a one-line documentation addition at head line 1274 of docs/provider/cli-reference.md, under the `darkbloom status` output list. It says App Attest serving authorization can remain visible through its unexpired lease, while MDM removal advice requires a matching fresh coordinator decision. It also says the same distinction applies to both doctor summaries, and it links to ../reference/provider-authorization.md.

No code, config or control paths change. The sentence is consistent with the threat model's TB-011 and T-053/T-057 language: a lease is bounded, expiring and connection-bound, and premature MDM removal must not strand a provider. It does not claim a new capability or relax any gate.

I also examined the rest of the supplied doc context (sandbox setup, addon hold, stop/restart, status, doctor) as unchanged text. Those sections only describe existing behavior. The one note is that the sandbox installer is not verified by the CLI beyond TLS. That is already documented, and T-061 / TB-013 cover it. It is not introduced by this PR.

Remaining unverified contract: whether the referenced provider-authorization.md page and the actual doctor/status code match the new sentence. Neither is in the supplied evidence. This is a documentation accuracy question, not a demonstrated regression.
